summary: Adds pyarrow==26.0.1 to the paper-fleet-reconciler image requirements and lock so runtime workers can read governed daily bars via DailyBarsReader; bounds the admission fill in governed_admission_replay_source and governed_market_dataset.resolve_governed_dataset to read only the member's symbols and the sessions it needs (plus warmup) without scanning the whole-market boundary or adding companion symbols; and keeps legacy per-binding *.lifecycle-outbox.json.member-books.json files during the reconciler's retired-binding sweep so the 3 recorded hosted marks (2026-11-20 to 2026-11-24) survive the 2026-11-27 10:00Z one-time envelope republish until the new runtime's first mark (~23:35Z) carries them into member-books/.

republish_race_timing.status_at_handoff: Prepared and handed off before the 2026-11-27T10:00Z daily cycle. When deployed to hosted before 2026-11-27T10:00Z, paper_fleet_reconciler._cleanup_retired_state_files keeps /data/runtime/paper-performance/rb-{2b0df305,a2cb762c,eb74118d}*.lifecycle-outbox.json.member-books.json when the 10:00Z one-time envelope republish (#7907) retires the old RuntimeBindings, so at the ~2026-11-27T23:35Z mark the 3 recorded marks (2026-11-20 to 2026-11-24) are carried in and the preceding 9 sessions (2026-11-09..2026-11-19) are filled from governed daily bars. If deployment reaches hosted after 2026-11-27T10:00Z, the old sweep will have deleted those 3 legacy per-binding files at 10:00Z so the 3 recorded marks are lost, and the governed replay fills all sessions from admission (2026-11-09..2026-11-26) at the ~23:35Z mark.

1_reconciler_image_pyarrow_reader.lock_only_test: services/research/tests/test_governed_market_dataset.py::test_reconciler_lock_carries_pyarrow_and_reads_governed_daily_bars_with_only_lock_packages runs a subprocess with a sys.meta_path guard derived from dependencies/locks/services-paper_fleet_reconciler.txt (verifying pandas, numpy, scipy, vectorbt fail with ModuleNotFoundError) and reads governed daily bars through governed_market_dataset and governed_admission_replay_source into MemberVirtualBooks.observe.

2_bounded_member_symbol_and_session_read.code_change: governed_admission_replay_source in services/execution/lean_runtime/member_virtual_book.py now calls resolve_governed_dataset with symbols=list(artifact['parameters']['symbols']), sessions=list(sessions), warmup_days=_required_warmup_days(artifact), min_instruments=1, and prepares PreparedVectorbtDataset via _prepare_replay_dataset (no 2-instrument companion requirement or 30-bar backtest gate floor). In services/research/governed_market_dataset.py, _reader sets ARROW_DEFAULT_MEMORY_POOL=system by default and _resolve_symbol_sessions reads only the requested symbols and the requested sessions (plus warmup_days stored trading days before the first session) one date at a time via DailyBarsReader.read_range(..., any_form=True), clearing _meta_cache and _manifest_cache after each date and shutting down the reader thread pool in finally. It never calls build_market_boundary or list_symbols across the whole market.
